title: geranium lusitanicum
intro: Geranium lusitanicum, commonly known as the Portuguese rose or wild geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving skin conditions, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Geranium lusitanicum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and anti-aging effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
